workflows.name: Arranging Windows
workflows.description: Control how new windows are placed and how existing ones behave.

steps.heading: Split Vertically
steps.description: The next window you open will be placed below this one.

steps.heading: Split Horizontally
steps.description: The next window you open will be placed beside this one.

steps.heading: Toggle Fullscreen
steps.description: Expand the focused window to fill the screen, and back again.

steps.heading: Toggle Floating
steps.description: Lift a window out of the tiling layout so it floats freely.
